description: This file contains utility functions and mock handlers for unit testing the RBUS core components. It includes mock implementations for getting and setting various data types, handling callbacks, and simulating method invocation, mainly used for testing purposes.

methods.name: void reset_stored_data()
methods.description: Resets internal static data buffers and counters to initial state.

methods.name: int handle_get1(const char * destination,const char * method,rbusMessage request,void * user_data,rbusMessage * response,const rtMessageHeader * hdr)
methods.description: Mock handler to get a string response stored in a static buffer.

methods.name: int handle_set1(const char * destination,const char * method,rbusMessage request,void * user_data,rbusMessage * response,const rtMessageHeader * hdr)
methods.description: Mock handler to set a string value received in the request.

methods.name: int handle_get2(const char * destination,const char * method,rbusMessage request,void * user_data,rbusMessage * response,const rtMessageHeader * hdr)
methods.description: Mock handler to return a string based on user data, with debug print.

methods.name: int handle_recursive_get(const char * destination,const char * method,rbusMessage request,void * user_data,rbusMessage * response,const rtMessageHeader * hdr)
methods.description: Simulates recursive method invocation and validates a payload.

methods.name: int handle_set2(const char * destination,const char * method,rbusMessage request,void * user_data,rbusMessage * response,const rtMessageHeader * hdr)
methods.description: Mock handler to set user data from request payload with debug printing.

methods.name: int handle_getStudentInfo(const char * destination,const char * method,rbusMessage request,void * user_data,rbusMessage * response,const rtMessageHeader * hdr)
methods.description: Returns student info if the object name matches in the internal list.

methods.name: int handle_setStudentInfo(const char * destination,const char * method,rbusMessage request,void * user_data,rbusMessage * response,const rtMessageHeader * hdr)
methods.description: Adds student info into internal list, using user_data for object name.

methods.name: int handle_getBinaryData(const char * destination,const char * method,rbusMessage request,void * user_data,rbusMessage * response,const rtMessageHeader * hdr)
methods.description: Returns static binary data stored in test_array1.

methods.name: int handle_setBinaryDataSize(const char * destination,const char * method,rbusMessage request,void * user_data,rbusMessage * response,const rtMessageHeader * hdr)
methods.description: Sets the global binary_data_size variable

methods.name: int handle_getLargeBinaryData(const char * destination,const char * method,rbusMessage request,void * user_data,rbusMessage * response,const rtMessageHeader * hdr)
methods.description: Returns multiple chunks of binary data based on binary_data_size.

methods.name: int handle_setBinaryData(const char * destination,const char * method,rbusMessage request,void * user_data,rbusMessage * response,const rtMessageHeader * hdr)
methods.description: Sets the internal test_array1 with incoming binary payload.

methods.name: int handle_getAttributes1(const char * destination,const char * method,rbusMessage request,void * user_data,rbusMessage * response,const rtMessageHeader * hdr)
methods.description: Returns attributes from test_struct1.

methods.name: int handle_setAttributes1(const char * destination,const char * method,rbusMessage request,void * user_data,rbusMessage * response,const rtMessageHeader * hdr)
methods.description: Sets attributes of test_struct1 from request.

methods.name: int handle_getAttributes2(const char * destination,const char * method,rbusMessage request,void * user_data,rbusMessage * response,const rtMessageHeader * hdr)
methods.description: Returns attributes from test_struct2.

methods.name: int handle_timeout(const char * destination,const char * method,rbusMessage request,void * user_data,rbusMessage * response,const rtMessageHeader * hdr)
methods.description: Simulates a delay based on request parameter.

methods.name: int handle_setAttributes2(const char * destination,const char * method,rbusMessage request,void * user_data,rbusMessage * response,const rtMessageHeader * hdr)
methods.description: Sets attributes of test_struct2 from request.

methods.name: void handle_unknown(const char * destination,const char * method,rbusMessage request,rbusMessage * response,const rtMessageHeader * hdr)
methods.description: Default handler for unsupported methods, sets error code.

methods.name: int callback(const char * destination,const char * method,rbusMessage message,void * user_data,rbusMessage * response,const rtMessageHeader * hdr)
methods.description: Generic callback that logs received message and calls handle_unknown for response.

methods.name: int sub1_callback(const char * object,const char * event,const char * listener,int added,const rbusMessage filter,void * data)
methods.description: Handles subscription notifications, logs details.
